# encapi Provider

Manage the Puppet External Node Classifier (encapi): roles, statuses (environments), and node role assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    encapi = {
      source = "IUCLabs/encapi"
    }
  }
}

provider "encapi" {
  endpoint = "https://encapi.example.com"
  # token defaults to the ENCAPI_WRITE_TOKEN environment variable
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) The encapi server base URL, e.g. `https://encapi.example.com`.

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Write token (bearer) for mutating operations. Defaults to the `ENCAPI_WRITE_TOKEN` environment variable.
